title: SAP Account Executive (m/w/d)
description:
Deine Aufgaben

Du weißt, dass du zu den Besten gehörst.  Dein Umfeld weiß es auch.  Aber deine aktuelle Rolle gibt dir nicht mehr den Raum, den du verdienst.   Du hast in den letzten Jahren Deals geschlossen, die andere für unmöglich hielten. Du kennst das SAP-Ökosystem nicht aus Präsentationen – sondern aus echten Co-Sell-Gesprächen, aus Partnerverhandlungen, aus Abschlüssen, die du persönlich über die Linie gebracht hast.  Jetzt fragst du dich: Gibt es eine Rolle, die meinem Anspruch wirklich gerecht wird?   Die gibt es. Und du liest sie gerade. 

Die Rolle

 Dies ist eine reine New-Business-Position mit klarer strategischer Bedeutung für Implicos Wachstum in SAP-zentrierten Prozessindustrien. Du verantwortest die Gewinnung neuer Kundenlogos in den Segmenten Landwirtschaft, Bergbau, Chemie sowie Zement und Baustoffe – in enger Co-Sell-Partnerschaft mit SAP Account Teams und Industry Business Units.  Du bewegst dich in einem Umfeld, in dem Vertrauen, Substanz und Marktkenntnisse entscheiden – nicht Lautstärke. 
 
Deine Verantwortung

  • Vollständige Quota-Verantwortung für neues ARR aus Prozessindustrie-Kunden
  • Identifikation und Qualifizierung von Opportunities aus der SAP-ADRM-Pipeline sowie dem eigenen Netzwerk
  • Aufbau und Pflege belastbarer Co-Sell-Beziehungen mit SAP SCM Sales Reps und IBU-Kontakten
  • Steuerung komplexer Sales-Zyklen von 3–9 Monaten mit mehreren Entscheidungsträgern auf IT-, Operations- und C-Level-Ebene
  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Solution Architects für technische Deep Dives und Proof-of-Value-Definitionen
  • Akkurate Pipeline-Führung im CRM sowie strukturiertes Forecasting
  • Kontinuierliche Rückmeldung von Markt- und Wettbewerbsinformationen an Product- und GTM-Teams


Dein Profil

Was wir voraussetzen:

  • Mindestens 5 Jahre B2B-Softwarevertrieb, davon mindestens 3 Jahre im SAP-Umfeld oder im strukturierten Co-Sell mit SAP
  • Nachweisliche Hunter-Bilanz: nachhaltig neue Kundenbeziehungen aufgebaut und abgeschlossen – nicht primär im Bestandsgeschäft
  • Tiefes Verständnis der SAP Channel- und Co-Sell-Mechanismen: Partnerdeals, RISE/GROW-Pipeline, SAP-Partnerökosystem
  • Erfahrung in der Steuerung von Multi-Stakeholder-Prozessen auf Entscheiderebene
  • Souveränes Auftreten auf C-Level – verbindlich, präzise, auf Augenhöhe
  • Ausgeprägte Eigenständigkeit in einem frühen, sich entwickelnden Go-to-Market-Setup
  • Verhandlungssichere Kenntnisse in Deutsch und Englisch
Was dich zusätzlich auszeichnet:
  • Branchenwissen in Landwirtschaft, Bergbau, Chemie oder Zement/Baustoffe
  • Bestehendes Netzwerk in der SAP SCM- oder Logistik-IBU-Community
  • Erfahrung im Vertrieb von SAP-Add-ons oder SolEx-Produkten
  • Vertrautheit mit Supply-Chain-Execution-, TM- oder Bulk-Logistik-Prozessen
 
Was du bei uns findest
  • Eine strategisch bedeutsame Rolle mit direktem Einfluss auf das Unternehmenswachstum
  • Klare Ziele, volle Autonomie in der Ausführung – kein Mikromanagement
  • Ungedeckeltes Vergütungsmodell – dein Upside spiegelt deinen Beitrag
  • Direkter Zugang zum SAP-Ökosystem und enge Zusammenarbeit mit erfahrenen Solution Architects
  • Ein Umfeld, das Seniorität respektiert und Eigenverantwortung erwartet
Du gestaltest – nicht nur mit. Du gestaltest, wie es wird.

 Implico ist kein fertig gebautes Konstrukt, das auf einen weiteren Vertriebsmitarbeiter wartet. Diese Rolle ist eine der ersten ihrer Art – du definierst mit, wie wir in den Prozessindustrien wahrgenommen werden, wie wir co-sellen, wie wir skalieren. Was du heute aufbaust, bleibt. Dein Fingerabdruck ist sichtbar – in der Kundenbasis, in der Marktpositionierung, in der Art, wie das Team in zwei Jahren arbeitet. Das ist kein Job. Das ist ein Gestaltungsauftrag.
 
Das Team – kein Versprechen, sondern eine Einladung.

 "Tolles Team" steht in jeder Stellenanzeige. Das überspringst du längst. Deshalb sagen wir es anders: Schau dir an, mit wem du zusammenarbeiten würdest.  Mark, Maurice, Anna, Thales, Selina und mehr. Menschen, die nicht wegen des Titels hier sind. Die morgens mit echtem Interesse an ihre Arbeit gehen. Die füreinander einspringen, ohne dass jemand fragen muss. Die über ihre Themen sprechen, als wären es ihre eigenen Projekte – weil sie es sind. Keine perfekte Hochglanz-Kultur. Aber eine, in der Leidenschaft und Haltung mehr zählen als Hierarchie.  Ob das zu dir passt? Das findest du nur heraus, wenn du das Gespräch suchst.
 
Der nächste Schritt

 Wenn du in den letzten Jahren bewiesen hast, dass du im SAP-Umfeld neue Märkte erschließt und Abschlüsse bringst dann freuen wir uns auf ein erstes, offenes Gespräch.  Kein langes Anschreiben. Zeig uns deinen Track Record – der Rest ergibt sich.

title: Trainee Frontend Development (m/w/d)
description:
Du willst Frontend nicht nur lernen, sondern an echten Projekten anwenden. Bei uns baust du vom ersten Tag an mit, begleitet, aber nicht an der Seitenlinie. 

BRANDUNG ist eine unabhängige Digitalagentur in Berlin. Wir entwickeln Websites, Shops und Applikationen: für bekannte Marken ebenso wie für NGOs und gemeinnützige Organisationen. Gearbeitet wird in Teams aus Frontend, Backend, Design und Projektmanagement. Als Trainee arbeitest du in genau diesen Teams mit, mit einem festen Mentor oder einer festen Mentorin aus dem Frontend-Team an deiner Seite.


Dein Spielfeld

Was dich erwartet

  • Ein 12-monatiges Traineeprogramm mit klarem Entwicklungsplan und dem Ziel der Übernahme
  • Feste Mentoren, regelmäßige Feedbackgespräche, Zeit für Lernen im Arbeitsalltag
  • Moderner Stack: TypeScript, React mit Next.js (App Router) oder Vue mit Nuxt 3
  • Code Reviews als Standard, Tests als Standard, keine Bastellösungen
  • KI-gestützte Entwicklung als Normalfall, nicht als Experiment: Wir arbeiten intensiv mit KI, und du lernst von Anfang an, damit sauber und kritisch umzugehen
 
Dein Alltag 
 
  • Du entwickelst Komponenten und Interfaces für die Websites, Shops und Applikationen unserer Kund:innen
  • Du wächst von einzelnen Komponenten zu ganzen Features
  • Du schreibst Tests und nimmst an Code Reviews teil, als Autor:in und als Reviewer:in
  • Du achtest auf Barrierefreiheit und Performance, weil beides zum Handwerk gehört
  • Du arbeitest im agilen Projektteam mit Backend, Design und Projektmanagement


Deine Skills

  • Solide HTML- und CSS-Kenntnisse und ein Gefühl dafür, wann Markup sauber ist
  • JavaScript-Grundlagen: du verstehst, was dein Code tut, nicht nur dass er läuft
  • Erste Berührung mit React oder Vue, egal ob aus Studium, Bootcamp, Umschulung oder eigenen Projekten
  • Neugier auf KI-Tools und die Bereitschaft, deren Ergebnisse zu hinterfragen statt blind zu übernehmen
  • Lust auf Feedback und die Fähigkeit, Fragen zu stellen, bevor du dich festfährst
  • Deutsch auf sehr gutem Niveau, Englisch zum Lesen von Doku
  • Formale Abschlüsse sind uns weniger wichtig als das, was du zeigen kannst. Ein GitHub-Profil, ein Nebenprojekt oder eine Bootcamp-Abschlussarbeit sagen mehr als ein Zeugnis.


Deine Benefits

  • Das Frontend bei BRANDUNG umfasst über 30 Entwickler:innen in mehreren Teams mit jeweils eigener Teamleitung. Für deine Fragen gibt es damit immer mehr als eine Ansprechperson.
  • Gemeinsam vor Ort, flexibel in der restlichen Woche. Mindestens zwei Tage pro Woche arbeiten wir gemeinsam im Berliner Office, die übrige Zeit teilst du dir selbst ein. Die Bürotage sind bewusst als gemeinsame Tage angelegt: Gerade in der Traineezeit lernst du im direkten Austausch deutlich schneller. Mittags kocht unser agentureigener Koch, jeden Tag frisch.
  • Qualität ist fester Bestandteil unseres Prozesses. Code Reviews, automatisierte Tests mit verbindlichen Coverage-Grenzen, statische Codeanalyse und Error Monitoring sind in jedem Projekt gesetzt. Du arbeitest von Beginn an nach diesen Standards, statt sie dir später aneignen zu müssen.
  • Wir entwickeln unsere KI-Werkzeuge selbst. Unser Code-Review-Agent und unsere Ticket-Automatisierung sind Eigenentwicklungen statt eingekaufter Tools. Wer daran mitarbeiten möchte, findet den Raum dafür, auch als Trainee.
  • Deine Entwicklung verläuft strukturiert. Neben dem Mentoring führst du regelmäßige Entwicklungsgespräche mit deiner Teamleitung: Standortbestimmung, Ziele, konkreter Bedarf. Hinzu kommt ein Frontend-Format, in dem Kolleg:innen ihre aktuelle Arbeit vorstellen. Anfangs als Zuhörer:in, später mit eigenen Beiträgen.


Kontaktinformationen

Schick uns deinen Lebenslauf und, falls vorhanden, einen Link zu Code oder Projekten. Kein Anschreiben nötig. Wir schauen uns jede Bewerbung persönlich an.

Gemeinsam machen wir digitales Arbeiten smarter und erfolgreicher – und du kannst einen wichtigen Beitrag dazu leisten.

Freue dich auf:

  • direkte Zusammenarbeit mit Marketing-, Sales- und Partner-Verantwortlichen sowie sichtbaren Impact auf unsere GTM-Strategie,

  • unbefristete Festanstellung in Vollzeit (40 Std.) ab 01.01.2027,
  • 30 Urlaubstage + jeweils einen freien Tag am 24.12. und 31.12.,
  • marktgerechtes Gehalt je nach Skill- und Erfahrungslevel,
  • offene Fehler- und Feedbackkultur,
  • tolle Weiterbildungs- und Weiterentwicklungsmöglichkeiten,
  • modernste Ausstattung, ergonomische Arbeitsplätze im Büro, Mitarbeitende werben Mitarbeitende-Programm, Zusammenhalt fördernde Events und spaßige Firmenfeiern, faire Regelungen zu Workations innerhalb der EU, vergünstigte Wellpass-Mitgliedschaft, Corporate Benefits & Co.


Deine Aufgaben

Du behältst bei mehreren Projekten gleichzeitig den Überblick, denkst in Prozessen und liebst es, Events und Partnerschaften von der Idee bis zur erfolgreichen Umsetzung zu bringen? Dann bist du hier genau richtig! Du als (Senior) Marketing Manager – Events & Partnerships (d/w/m*) verantwortest unsere Marketing Kanäle Events und Partnerships vollumfänglich – von der Strategie bis zur operativen Umsetzung.

Was dich erwartet:

  • Messe- & Event-Management: Du planst und steuerst unsere Auftritte auf Messen wie der DMEXCO und der K5 von Stand- und Eventkonzept über Budget, Bewerbung und Durchführung bis hin zur Nachbereitung inklusive Lead-Übergabe an den Vertrieb.
  • Online Events: Du planst und steuerst unsere Webinare, egal ob selbst gehostet oder durch Partner/Plattformen. Bei dir laufen alle Fäden zusammen von der Konzeption über Projektmanagement bis zur Erfolgskontrolle.
  • Partner-Marketing & Enablement: Du konzipierst und organisierst Formate wie Meet-ups oder einen virtuellen Partner-Day und baust unser Partner-Enablement kontinuierlich aus.
  • Schnittstellenfunktion: Du arbeitest als Teil des Marketings eng mit Sales, CSM und externen Partnern zusammen und stellst sicher, dass alle Projekte termingerecht, budgetkonform und mit klarem Erfolgsmaß umgesetzt werden.


Dein Profil

Bei uns zählt jede einzelne Person – dein Impact macht den Unterschied. Wir suchen eine Person, die unsere Kanäle 'Events' & 'Partnerships' nicht nur organisiert, sondern strategisch weiterentwickelt – mit Hands-on-Mentalität und einem Gespür für Priorisierung.

Idealerweise bringst du zudem folgende Qualifikationen mit:

  • Erfahrung im Marketing (Events, Partnerships): Du hast mindestens 4-5 Jahre Erfahrung im B2B Marketing, am Besten mit Kampagnen- oder Eventmanagement Schwerpunkt, bevorzugt in der SaaS oder Tech-Branche.
  • Budget- & Ressourcenkontrolle: Du hast Erfahrung in der effizienten Steuerung von Event- und Marketing-Budgets und behältst Kosten sowie Ressourceneinsatz jederzeit im Blick.
  • Verhandlungsgeschick: Du verhandelst sicher mit Partnern, Dienstleistern und Sponsoring-Partnern und erzielst dabei für beide Seiten Deals mit Mehrwert.
  • Analytisches Mindset: Du misst und analysierst den Erfolg deiner Maßnahmen anhand klarer KPIs und triffst Entscheidungen datenbasiert statt aus dem Bauch heraus. Du hast immer einen Blick darauf, wo wir noch effizienter werden können und wo Potenziale für Skalierung liegen.
  • Organisationstalent mit Umsetzungsstärke: Du behältst bei mehreren parallelen Projekten den Überblick, setzt Prioritäten und lieferst zuverlässig termingerecht.
  • Eigenverantwortung: Du übernimmst Ownership für deine Projekte und triffst Entscheidungen eigenständig, ohne dabei den Blick fürs große Ganze zu verlieren.
  • Reisebereitschaft: Du bist bereit, für Messen und Partner-Events gelegentlich zu reisen.
  • Deutsch (C1/C2) & Englisch (mind. B2): Du bewegst dich sicher in nationalen sowie internationalen Partnerbeziehungen.

title: Senior Manager Recruiting & Employer Branding (m/f/d)
description:
Intro

Willkommen bei Sanoptis – einem führenden Netzwerk moderner Augenkliniken und augenärztlicher Praxen mit über 480 Standorten in ganz Europa. Unsere Vision ist es, Wohlbefinden und Lebensqualität durch erstklassige augenärztliche Behandlung zu verbessern. Unser innovatives, dezentrales Modell ermöglicht es unseren Partnerstandorten, unabhängig zu operieren und sich auf die individuellen Bedürfnisse ihrer Patienten zu konzentrieren. Gleichzeitig sind sie Teil eines größeren Netzwerks mit starken Partnern, das ihnen Synergieeffekte, modernste Technik und viele weitere Vorteile bietet.

Du bist ein Talent-Experte und weißt, wie eine Arbeitgebermarke repräsentativ zu etablieren ist und die besten Talente zu gewinnen sind?

In unserem People-Team bist Du für den gesamten Rekrutierungsprozess der Sanoptis-Gruppe verantwortlich. Du steuerst die Besetzung unserer offenen Stellen in 6 europäischen Ländern (DACH, Spanien, Italien, Griechenland). Du entwickelst und etablierst Best Practices, um die Standardisierung zu erhöhen und Synergien innerhalb unseres Netzwerks zu nutzen. Gemeinsam mit uns etablierst Du Sanoptis als den Employer-of-Choice am Markt.

Die Position ist zunächst als Elternzeitvertretung auf 18 Monate befristet.


In dieser Rolle wirst Du

  • Unsere Recruiting-Prozesse entwerfen und steuern: Du trägst die Verantwortung für alle Rekrutierungsaktivitäten der Sanoptis-Gruppe, einschließlich Stellenbeschreibungen, Kanalplanung, Active Sourcing, Bewerberauswahl und Durchführung von Erstgesprächen.
  • Unsere Metriken im Blick behalten und auswerten: Du wirst unsere KPI-Dashboards zur Überwachung der Leistung von Rekrutierungsaktivitäten steuern, auswerten und daraus Daten und evidenzbasierte Handlungen ableiten.
  • Unsere Recruitment-Partner intern und extern steuern: Du wirst Partner wie Stellenportale, Headhunter oder Personalagenturen steuern, Verträge prüfen und Preise verhandeln, um uns stets den besten Zugang zu Talenten zu sichern. Dabei steuerst Du auch Rekrutierungskampagnen in enger Zusammenarbeit mit unserem Marketingteam. Zusätzlich schulst Du die Personalverantwortlichen der Kliniken zur Verbesserung ihrer Recruitingaktivitäten.
  • Recruiting mit KI weiterentwickeln: Du beobachtest relevante KI-Trends und nutzt Claude gezielt, um Recruiting-Prozesse zu automatisieren und zu optimieren sowie KI-basierte Projekte eigenständig voranzutreiben.
  • Unsere Employer-Brand-Strategie umsetzen: Du stärkst die Sanoptis Employer Brand und entwickelst unsere Außenauftrittem, insbesondere auf LinkedIn, kununu und weiteren relevanten Plattformen, kontinuierlich weiter.


Du wirst zusammenarbeiten mit

  • Der Head of People Angelina Budes als Deine Führungskraft.
  • Dem globalen People-Team, welches in Recruiting, L&D und People Business Partnering unterteilt ist.
  • Entscheidungsträgern wie Head-ofs, C-Level Executives und Hiring Managern, wenn es um die Einstellung der besten Talente geht.
  • Vielen weiteren Stakeholdern im gesamten Unternehmen durch Hiring-Prozesse, Trainings und weitere Recruiting-Maßnahmen, die Du leitest.


Dein Profil überzeugt durch

  • Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung im Recruiting oder Personalwesen.
  • Erfahrung im internationalen Stakeholder-Management. Idealerweise hast Du bereits in einem Private-Equity-Umfeld gearbeitet.
  • Affinität zu KI-Anwendungen, insbesondere Claude; praktische Erfahrung mit KI-gestützten Recruiting-Prozessen und -Projekten ist ein Plus.
  • Erfahrung mit ATS-Systemen (z.B. Personio).
  • Ausgeprägte analytische, konzeptionelle und strategische Fähigkeiten und idealerweise Erfahrung im Projektmanagement.
  • Emotionale Intelligenz sowie hervorragende zwischenmenschliche und kommunikative Fähigkeiten.
  • Deutschkenntnisse auf C2-Niveau sowie Englischkenntnisse auf mindestens C1-Niveau.

  • Eigenständigkeit und kreative Freiheit: Die Möglichkeit, selbstständig zu arbeiten und sich mit innovativen Ideen einzubringen, dank flacher Hierarchien und kurzer Entscheidungswege, was unsere Organisation stärkt.

  • Inklusive Kultur: Arbeite in einem talentierten und vielfältigen Team mit einer herzlichen Bürokultur und Teamveranstaltungen.
  • Mitarbeiterrabatte: Vergünstigte Konditionen auf zahlreiche ausgewählte Markenprodukte und Dienstleistungen über unseren Partner Corporate Benefits.

title: Head of Brand & Marketing (m/w/d)
description:
Wir wollen die lautesten Handpulled Noodles Europas werden. Dafür fehlt uns die Person, die das kreativ führt.

Bang Bang Noodles macht Handpulled Noodles. Jede Nudel von Hand gezogen, mitten im Restaurant, so dass du es siehst, hörst und spürst. Heute zwei Stores in Berlin, Kreuzberg und Mitte. Morgen deutlich mehr: Wir bauen gerade das Franchise System auf und wollen im nächsten Jahr fünf weitere Standorte eröffnen, auch außerhalb Berlins. Dazu ein starkes Team und ein Markengesicht, das schon heute Reichweite hat.

Not authentic. Just really good. Wir erzählen keine Traditionsgeschichten. Wir zeigen, was wir können, und wir sind dabei laut. Mit Absicht.

Was uns fehlt, ist die Person, die diese Haltung jeden Tag in Content, Kampagnen und Markenauftritt übersetzt. Nicht als Verwalter, sondern als Motor.

Aufgaben

  • Du führst die Marke. Tonalität, Look, Guidelines, und du hast das letzte Wort bei allem, was BBN nach außen zeigt: Content, Karte, Stores, Merch, Kooperationen.
  • Du baust unser Content System. Formate für TikTok, Reels und Stories, ein Redaktionsplan, feste Drehroutinen mit unserer Gründerin als Gesicht und der Küche als Bühne.
  • Du produzierst selbst. Handy raus, drei Clips in der Küche, schneiden, posten. Du bist dabei nicht allein: Im Team gibt es Leute, die filmen und schneiden können und dich an festen Tagen unterstützen, und für größere Drehs holst du Freelancer und führst sie.
  • Du entwickelst Brand Momente, die Berlin mitbekommt, von der Idee bis zur Umsetzung, und steuerst Agenturen und Freelancer, wenn es welche braucht.
  • Du lieferst Creatives für Paid Social und holst dir die Learnings zurück in die Planung. Paid selbst liegt aktuell beim Founder und kann perspektivisch zu dir wandern.
  • Du bringst die Marke in jeden Kiez. Lokales Marketing für die bestehenden Stores und vor allem für Neueröffnungen: Launch Kampagnen, Nachbarschaft, Creator, Events. Beim Opening bist du vor Ort, auch wenn es in einer anderen Stadt ist.
  • Du machst die Marke auch nach innen sichtbar: Employer Brand für unser Recruiting und Material und Playbooks für unsere Franchise Partner, damit jeder Standort so laut ist wie der erste.
  • Du hast ein eigenes Produktionsbudget und entscheidest, wofür es draufgeht.

Qualifikation

  • Mindestens fünf Jahre in Brand, Content oder Kreation, angestellt oder in der Agentur. Und du hast an mindestens einer Marke mitgearbeitet, die man erkennt, weil sie Charakter hat. Consumer, Food, Lifestyle, egal welche Branche.
  • Du kannst es selbst. Kurze Videos mit dem Handy drehen und schneiden, Texte schreiben, Plattformen bedienen. Kein Profi Cutter nötig, aber auch kein reiner Stratege.
  • Du verstehst TikTok und Instagram aus der Praxis, nicht aus Reports.
  • Geschmack und Haltung. Du sagst nein, wenn etwas nicht zur Marke passt, auch zu uns.
  • Deutsch und Englisch sicher. Du bist in Berlin und willst in den Stores sein, nicht nur im Büro.

title: Senior Product Owner - Data & Analytics (m/f/d)
description:
About Yepoda

Our mission is to bring Clean K-Beauty Innovations, from Korea straight to Europe, UK, and the US – without ever compromising on our values, quality, and sustainability. Our clean, mindfully produced skincare products are made with love in Korea, vegan, cruelty-free, and packed with the best natural and active ingredients.

Founded in 2020 by Sander Joonyoung van Bladel and Veronika Strotmann, Yepoda is a fast-growing beauty start-up based in the heart of Berlin. Our products are available across Europe and, since March 2025, at Sephora Europe – online and in over 250 stores. As a certified B Corp™, we are committed to building a business with purpose. With a team of over 120 brilliant individuals from around the world, we are actively shaping Yepoda’s story every day.

 

We are looking for a Senior Data & Analytics Product Owner to join our growing Data team at Yepoda. In this role, you will partner closely with our Head of Data & Technology to shape how we build and ship data and analytics products across the business — driving alignment with stakeholders, prototyping ideas hands-on, and making sure our data capabilities translate into real commercial outcomes.

 

Your Tasks

  • Own the company-wide analytics function, i.e., the KPI framework, reporting cadence, BI tooling/glossary, and our decision-support and reporting standards.

  • Own the product delivery roadmap for data initiatives for Yepoda's central Data analytics team.

  • Translate commercial questions (CAC/LTV, channel mix, contribution margin, cohort behaviour, inventory turnover, etc.) from Marketing, Operations, Finance and other functions into scoped, prioritized data products and repeatable analyses.

  • Write product requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria that data engineering and analytics teams can execute against without ambiguity. Be the person who closes the gap between "the business wants something" and "the team knows what to build."

  • Lead discovery and drive experimentation with stakeholders for new data capabilities, from self-serve analytics tooling to ML-powered features.

     

Your Profile

  • 3-5 years in a product management or product owner role in BI or Analytics or closely adjacent role at a relevant D2C, e-commerce, or consumer brand.

  • Strong business understanding, you think in terms of impact, not just output. Deep understanding of D2C metrics (e.g., CAC, LTV, CIR/ROAS, contribution margin, cohort analytics, marketing attribution, etc).

  • Exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills. Proven ability to operate at C-level, translating fuzzy commercial questions into sharp, defensible analyses

  • Comfortable operating in ambiguity and moving fast in a startup environment. You create structure rather than waiting for it.

  • Excellent written and spoken English.

 

Nice to Have

  • Exposure to modern data stack concepts (data warehouses, Self-Serve Analytics tools, ML pipelines); you don't need to build them, but knowing the landscape helps.

  • Experience writing SQL or working directly with data and AI tools such as Omni and Claude.

 

What We Offer

  • Dynamic Environment: The opportunity to work in a start-up environment surrounded by a passionate and dedicated team.

  • Accelerate Your Career: Take on responsibility from day 1, with room for professional growth and advancement as the company continues to expand.

  • Inspiring Workspace: Located in the heart of Berlin's Prenzlauer Berg, a dog-friendly office, with free drinks and snacks.

  • Hybrid Working: We understand that sometimes you get more stuff done from home and need a change of scenery.

  • We Value Diversity: We seek to build an inclusive workplace that welcomes people from all different backgrounds. A welcoming, international, dedicated team with flat hierarchies and trust by default.

  • Employee Discounts: You’ll get to enjoy the Yepoda products at a discount and share it with friends and family to keep your glow going!

  • Unique Add Ons: A monthly benefits budget that's yours to spend. Through the Probonio app you pick what actually fits your lifestyle.

     

Would you like to be part of the team? Then we'd love to hear from you! 🫰✨

Make sure to apply by clicking on the “Apply for this job” button below. Please upload your CV and Cover Letter in English language. Our Talent Acquisition team will review your application and get back to you as soon as possible.

At Yepoda we are dedicated to providing equal employment opportunities to all individuals, regardless of race, color, ethnicity, ancestry, religion, national origin, citizenship, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, parental status, disability, or any other status protected by applicable law.

You enable others to answer their own questions and automate their own work without asking permission.

You make voize a fully AI-native organization and enable all team members with the tools and the knowledge to automate everything that doesn’t need a human doing it and help them to focus on what is really important.

  • Deliver AI into the business functions: from spotting the use case through deployment to measured operating impact function by function.

  • Drive cultural change: You make voize an organization where every decision is based on reliable data and AI does all the work that doesn’t need to be done by humans anymore.

  • Own governance and risk in a regulated healthcare setting in partnership with our compliance team: privacy, data protection, model risk, EU AI Act

  • Build the function: build the Data and Internal AI function and hire and manage the team. Decide what stays central and what is handled by a de-central team of AI Champions.

  • You have built and owned a modern data foundation hands-on — cloud warehouse, dbt from staging through marts with tests and CI, a semantic layer, canonical metrics, self-serve BI as well as hired the right people to scale it. You've built it, grew a team, not just specified it for someone else

  • You have a track record of data or AI changing a business metric, past pilot, with numbers you can walk through end to end

  • You are effective across a whole company as credible with Support and Sales as with Engineering, and you'd rather build a champions network than hand-hold every team yourself

  • You own governance and risk rather than treating it as someone else's blocker, and you run autonomously: you set your own priorities in ambiguity and deliver one source and one team end to end before proposing a program

ABOUT US

METYCLE: where innovation meets sustainability
We are reshaping the global secondary metals industry to accelerate the circular flow of metals. By combining global trading, advanced processing and digital intelligence, we make secondary metals more predictable, transparent and scalable, strengthening industrial supply chains and reducing reliance on primary metal production.
And the impact is significant: recycling aluminium can reduce greenhouse gas emissions by up to 95% compared with primary aluminium production.
And we take it further! Our SmartSorting Hubs combine advanced sorting technology, automation and AI to transform how complex scrap is processed, turning selected mixed streams into better-defined industrial feedstock while improving material quality and traceability.Join us at a defining stage as we bring the $600 billion scrap metals industry into the 21st century and build a new global standard for secondary metals.


READY TO MAKE AN IMPACT?

We are looking for an experienced Data Analyst who turns complex operational and business data into clear insights, better decisions, and measurable improvements. You bring strong hands-on experience in data analysis, SQL, visualisation, and working with large and imperfect datasets - and understand how to connect data to real-world processes and business outcomes.
This is an integrated role at the intersection of business, operations, and technology. You’ll work directly with teams to understand their data needs, dig into the details hands-on, and find the right way to answer their questions - whether through SQL, Excel, dashboards, or other tools. You’ll also translate recurring needs into requirements for Engineering and help build stable, automated reporting and analytics over time, particularly across our trading business.
Join our international team and play a key role in shaping innovative solutions for scrap metal processing - using data and technology to build a more efficient and sustainable future.


YOUR MISSION

  • Analytics & Insights: Turn complex business questions into clear, actionable analysis, identifying trends, opportunities, risks, and the key drivers behind business performance. Work directly with the people who have the data need to understand their questions, challenge assumptions, and turn raw data into meaningful insights and decisions.
  • Data Foundations: Build and maintain the data transformations needed to turn raw data into clean, reliable, analysis-ready datasets in the Data Warehouse. Work hands-on with imperfect data, validate its accuracy and meaning, and identify gaps or inconsistencies in how data is captured.
  • Data Modelling: Translate business requirements into well-structured, reusable data models and clearly defined metrics that provide a trusted source of truth for analytics across the organisation.
  • Data Quality: Implement and maintain data quality checks and tests to ensure data is accurate, consistent, complete, and fresh - proactively identifying and resolving issues with relevant stakeholders and working with Engineering to improve how underlying data is captured.
  • Reporting & Self-Service: Build and support dashboards, reports, and analytical datasets that are intuitive, performant, and optimised for internal reporting and self-service analytics. Help turn recurring analytical needs and ad-hoc analysis into stable, scalable, and increasingly automated reporting.
  • Stakeholder Partnership: Work closely with Product, Operations, Finance, Marketing, Engineering, and other teams to understand business needs, challenge assumptions, and translate them into meaningful analytical questions and solutions. Communicate effectively across different levels and functions, from discussing detailed data questions with technical teams to presenting clear insights and recommendations to senior stakeholders.
  • Documentation & Standards: Maintain clear documentation for datasets, transformations, metrics, and data lineage using dbt Docs or similar tools, and contribute to practical standards for SQL, data modelling, testing, and visualisation.
  • Automation & AI: Identify manual or inefficient analytical workflows and improve them through automation, modern data tooling, and AI-assisted analysis - using AI to accelerate data exploration, querying, documentation, and reporting while maintaining a strong understanding of and control over the underlying data.


YOUR PROFILE

description:
ABOUT US

METYCLE - where innovation meets sustainability

We are building the B2B online platform to accelerate the global circular flow of secondary metals. By connecting buyers and sellers of scrap metal globally, we enable efficient trade of secondary metals and drive the seamless flow of recycling material, essential for reducing CO2 emissions by up to 95% compared to primary metal production.

READY TO MAKE AN IMPACT?

If you are passionate about industrial automation, solving complex technical challenges, and building something from the ground up, join our team as an Industrial Automation Engineer.

The machinery is the easy part to buy. The control system that turns it into a plant - and the standards, documentation, and data that keep it running - is what we are hiring you to own.

We are looking for an experienced Industrial Automation Engineer to take ownership of our plant’s control systems from design through commissioning and into stable production. You bring deep hands-on experience in programming and commissioning industrial control systems and are comfortable taking responsibility for the PLC, safety systems, HMI, industrial networking, and interfaces between multiple machine suppliers.

Beyond programming, you understand what it takes to make a plant genuinely reliable in production and have the technical confidence to hold suppliers to high professional standards. Join our international team, help build innovative solutions for scrap metal processing, and contribute to a more sustainable future.


YOUR MISSION

  • PLC & Plant Control: Design, write, and own the PLC program using Siemens TIA Portal / S7-1200 & S7-1500, including control logic, sequencing, fault handling, and HMI
  • Commissioning & Production: Take the plant from design through commissioning to a stable, running line, owning the full journey through FAT/SAT and the hands-on work required to make the plant genuinely reliable
  • Plant Availability: Design stop and interlock behaviour to minimise unnecessary downtime — allowing unaffected parts of the plant to keep running when it is safe to do so. Plant availability is a direct business outcome here, and you will directly influence it
  • Machine Safety: Implement the machine-safety control concept on a fail-safe F-CPU with F-I/O, including the hardwired e-stop loop, PLC-enforced zone isolation that cannot be overridden, guard interlocks, and controlled, sequenced shutdown
  • Safety & Compliance: Be our in-house technical counterpart on EN ISO 13849 performance-level determination and the CE file, working with external assessors while retaining ownership of the technical approach and decisions
  • Machine Integration: Integrate control systems from several different machine suppliers into one coherent line, so that a single stop is genuinely a single stop across the whole plant
  • Supplier Management: Hold machine builders and panel builders to specification, including unlocked code, complete documentation, and standards compliance
  • OT / IT & Industrial IoT: Get plant data out over OPC UA / MQTT / Modbus TCP into our own systems, so stoppage reasons, energy use, and throughput become actionable data. Work closely with our Industrial IoT team, who own the edge and data side of that boundary


YOUR PROFILE

  • 5+ years of hands-on experience programming and commissioning industrial control systems, with a track record of bringing production equipment or complete lines into stable operation
  • Deep Siemens TIA Portal / S7-1200 & S7-1500 experience, with strong skills in SCL, LAD/FBD, HMI/SCADA, industrial networking (PROFINET, PROFIBUS, Modbus TCP), drives/VFDs, and fault-finding
  • Strong machine safety competence, including F-CPU / Safety Integrated and EN ISO 13849, with the ability to explain and defend performance-level determinations
  • Comfortable reading electrical schematics and troubleshooting cabinets, hardware, signals, wiring, and control behaviour directly on the shop floor. You have brought at least one production line from commissioning into stable production; maintenance-only experience is not sufficient
  • Experience working with machine and panel builders, with the confidence to hold suppliers accountable for code quality, documentation, standards compliance, and professional delivery
  • Experience with brownfield projects and legacy migration (STEP 7 Classic → TIA); experience in bulk material handling, recycling, sorting, or minerals processing is a plus
  • Experience with PLC version control, simulation / digital twins, or structured automation approaches is desirable. Additional IT/OT skills such as Python, C#/TIA Openness, SQL, Linux, Docker, MES/IIoT, OT network segmentation, or IEC 62443 are a plus

description:
About WPP Production

We are WPP Production - the unified global production company that brings together all of WPP's content producers, studios and craft experts into one connected organisation. We combine world-class human craft with next generation technology to originate, design, and deliver multi-channel content systems at scale. Built for borderless collaboration and powered by deep craft expertise, we are the production engine designed for today's always on, AI driven marketing world.

About WPP

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world's leading brands. We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit WPP.com.

A Hybrid working model

We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we've adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around 4 days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.

What does a Senior Post Producer do at WPP Production?

You'll play a central role in delivering high-quality post-production projects across edit, grade, VFX, motion, and sound. As a Senior Post Producer you will bridge hands-on production and leadership, managing key projects, supporting producers, and maintaining strong relationships with clients, agencies, and creative partners. You'll ensure projects run smoothly, budgets are met, and the creative standard remains high across everything that leaves the studio. You'll be someone who thrives on collaboration, solves problems calmly under pressure, and takes pride in delivering work that looks, sounds, and feels exceptional. The ideal candidate will have experience working with a global technology brand or demonstrate a strong drive and ambition to contribute to a high-calibre account. 

Responsibilities

Production

  • Lead multiple post-production projects from brief to final delivery, managing timelines, budgets and workflows.
  • Oversee offline, online, grade, VFX, motion graphics and audio, ensuring projects are delivered on time and to a high standard.
  • Own production workflows, tracking progress, risks and budgets and keeping the Executive Producer informed.
  • Proactively identify and resolve challenges, balancing creative, technical and commercial priorities.
  • Manage global workflows across a centralised production hub and continuously improve ways of working.
  • Explore and implement AI and emerging technologies to improve efficiency, quality and output.

Clients & Collaboration

  • Act as a senior point of contact for clients and agency partners throughout production.
  • Lead client calls, reviews and presentations, building trusted relationships and managing expectations.
  • Collaborate closely with creatives, artists, technical teams and senior production leads to deliver high-quality work.
  • Support and mentor junior and mid-level producers, sharing best practice and fostering a collaborative team environment.

Quality & Commercial

  • Own the studio QC process, ensuring work meets brand, technical and delivery standards.
  • Develop and implement robust QC workflows and best practices.
  • Prepare budgets and estimates, maintaining accurate financial tracking and identifying opportunities to improve efficiency.
  • Contribute to rate cards, templates and processes that strengthen production and commercial performance.

Requirements

  • Strong post-production experience across broadcast, digital and social.
  • Senior-level experience managing complex, high-end campaigns from brief to delivery.
  • Strong understanding of the full post-production pipeline, including edit, colour, online, VFX and audio.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple projects, priorities and stakeholders in a fast-paced environment.
  • Excellent communicator, confident working with clients, agency partners and internal teams.
  • Experience managing international clients and senior stakeholders across multiple markets.
  • Calm, organised and solutions-focused, with the ability to stay composed under pressure.
  • Collaborative team player who leads by example and supports the development of others.
  • Passionate about craft, creativity, technology and innovation, with a strong eye for detail and efficiency.
  • Genuine interest in technology brands and the wider tech landscape.
  • Flexible and adaptable when project deadlines require occasional evening or weekend support. We value work-life balance and these instances are infrequent, with time off in lieu provided where appropriate.

#LI-LS1

title: Senior Security Engineer - Contract
description:
What is Flagstone?

Flagstone is many things. An online savings platform, reinventing how individuals, businesses, and charities manage, protect, and grow their cash. A diverse group of people, bound by a collaborative spirit, and shared purpose. And lastly, a thriving, profitable business – where smart people do their best work.

Each definition shares a common thread: our unique culture. It’s our pride and joy. And our competitive advantage.

A feel for our culture:

To revolutionise the savings market, we need to be at our best. But high performance takes more than talent – it takes a culture of kindness, respect, and growth.

That’s why we’re building a diverse, inclusive community, where your voice is heard and valued. Where, with close support and room to develop, you can surpass even your own expectations. And be rewarded for it.

We may not change the world, but we can change the world of financial technology. And all it takes is a winning mix of drive, talent, and empathy. Our culture celebrates all three.

But enough about us. Let’s talk about you.


About the team
Security Engineering is a team of five covering cloud security, detection, and security operations. They work directly in the Azure estate and are close to the infrastructure, not abstracted behind a policy layer. The team runs Microsoft Sentinel, Defender XDR, and Defender for Cloud, and manages tooling through infrastructure-as-code. They run a quarterly penetration test programme and are continuously building out our detection and response capability. It's a small team with broad scope, which means your work is visible, your opinions are heard, and there are meaningful problems for our engineers to work on.

This is a contract role, so we're looking for someone who can hit the ground running. You'll bring immediate impact and add value from day one, working independently without a long ramp-up. Your work will be visible, and the problems you solve will matter.


Does this sound like you?
You're a senior security engineer who operates credibly across cloud security, detection tooling, and incident response, without being narrowly specialised. You own meaningful parts of the security stack, contribute hands-on to Azure cloud hardening, and show up reliably when incidents need investigating or pen test cycles need coordinating. You're energised by visible impact, your work matters, and your voice is heard.

 

What you’ll do:

  • Own and operate our alerting and monitoring capability through a transition period, keeping detection and response steady.

  • Maintain and improve our Microsoft Sentinel deployment: writing and tuning detection rules, managing data connectors, and reducing alert noise.

  • Operate and optimise Defender XDR and Defender for Cloud, including policy management and posture recommendations.

  • Maintain and extend automated security checks in our delivery pipelines (shift-left).

  • Drive down time-to-fix on known vulnerabilities, coordinating remediation with engineering squads.

  • Support data-loss-prevention controls that reduce the risk of sensitive data leaving the business.

  • Support safeguards around how the business accesses and uses AI, including securing AI workloads and their data exposure.

  • Investigate suspicious activity surfaced through Sentinel and Defender: triage, escalate, or contain as appropriate.

  • Support incident response, including containment, evidence gathering, and post-incident review.

  • Contribute to detection-as-code and infrastructure-as-code (Terraform or Bicep) for security tooling.

  • Coordinate penetration test engagements (scope, logistics, findings review) and work with engineering teams to prioritise remediation.
     

What you’ll bring:

  • Hands-on SIEM experience, ideally Microsoft Sentinel; equivalent platforms (Splunk, Chronicle, QRadar) considered.

  • Practical Azure security experience across Defender for Cloud, Entra ID, Azure networking, and cloud security posture management.

  • Experience writing infrastructure-as-code using Terraform or Bicep in a security engineering context.

  • Experience driving vulnerability remediation cycles with engineering squads.

  • Familiarity with data-loss-prevention controls.

  • Familiarity with AI security considerations (securing AI workloads, data exposure risks) and/or using AI tooling to augment security engineering workflows.

  • Ability to contribute to threat modelling and communicate security risk clearly to engineering and product audiences.

  • A growth mindset and genuine curiosity to keep learning.

  • SC-200 (Microsoft Security Operations Analyst) certification.

  • KQL proficiency for detection rule authoring and threat hunting.

  • Experience working in a similar fintech or financial services environment
     

All are welcome:

At Flagstone, we’re assembling a diverse team that defies our industry’s norms. Think this role could suit you? We encourage you to apply, no matter your background.

title: Accounts Payable Assistant
description:

MUBI is a global streaming service, production company and film distributor dedicated to elevating great cinema. To make this possible, we create, curate, acquire and champion visionary films, bringing them to audiences all over the world. We have a team of brilliant, dedicated and passionate people to help bring our mission to life. From London to New York, Istanbul to Paris, and Berlin to Mexico - we work together to realize MUBI’s vision.

That’s where you come in! Join our global team and help us make great cinema accessible to everyone, everywhere.

About the Role

MUBI has grown spectacularly over the last few years. This has been accompanied by increases in volumes of transactions with the numerous partners that MUBI works with, as well as increased staff expenditures on business activities.

As part of a small team, this Accounts Payable Assistant role within the London-based Finance team will become an expert in handling these areas, and will play a crucial part in helping the team to grow its capabilities in line with MUBI’s long-term business plan.

On a daily basis, the role will involve processing inbound requests from external suppliers and internal colleagues, leading on communications with stakeholders to solve problems, and working closely with other members of the Finance team.

We work hybrid-remote where we require 3 office days in London. Our core days are Tuesday, Wednesday & Thursday, with the flexibility to use our offices on the remaining two days if you wish.

Where you’ll have impact:

  • Run the accounts payable transactional processes:

    • Process incoming invoices from suppliers, ensuring these have been approved by budget holders and then entered accurately into the finance system

    • Process staff expense claims and ensuring these are correctly documented, approved in line with policies, and entered in the finance system

    • Manage weekly payment runs to ensure suppliers and employees are paid correctly according to internal policies

    • Match payments to supplier accounts within the finance system, as part of the wider bank reconciliation processes

    • Own inbound accounts payable emails and queries

  • Develop and run existing and new accounts payable control processes:

    • Connecting with your counterparts at our suppliers to reconcile ledger accounts and understand and solve any invoicing discrepancies

    • Suggest and implement improvements to processes for staff expense claims and company credit card expenditures

    • Where tasks are consistent and repeatable, work with others in the team to develop automated processes

  • Contribute to the monthly accounting close process:

    • Maintain monthly prepayments and accruals schedules

    • Identify significant expenses that have not been invoiced, for inclusion in the monthly accruals schedule

What you’ll bring:

  • Experience in a role running regular transactional processes, ideally in a medium- or large-sized company.

  • Attention to detail - a single digit error can be meaningful when it comes to payments.

  • Pride in delivering high quality and proactive ownership of your area of responsibility.

  • Working experience with Google Sheets or Microsoft Excel is essential.

  • A growth mindset where you can demonstrate an interest in both the development of your role and your own personal development. MUBI is a growing business and we want you to grow with it in a role suited to your skills and experience.

  • Experience in international payments, including to the US, Canada, LATAM, and EU countries, as well as UK payees (preferred).

  • You may have started studying for, or recently completed, a Finance qualification such as AAT or ACCA/CIMA foundation level (preferred).

We want to make cinema accessible to everyone. We believe people from different backgrounds bring different ideas that foster innovation and engagement, allowing us to attract great people to develop the best experience for our users.

title: Front-end Engineer
description:
Comand AI's mission is to build next-generation C2 software with real users in real deployments. We are fully indexed on the success of every user, the interfaces you ship support live operations.

You'd join the product development team as a front-end specialist, working closely with product design and engineering. You take an operational problem, explore it, come back with proposals, and iterate. Delivering a clear, fast and dependable user experience is critical to the person using it.

What this looks like in practice:

  • Own front-end delivery on Prevail, our operational planning platform, from interaction design through production

  • Build interfaces for real geospatial problems: interactive maps, multiple data layers, large datasets, and time-sensitive workflows well beyond a typical CRUD application

  • Work with product and design early, turning operational needs into clear flows and production-ready experiences

  • Raise the front-end quality bar across the team by reviewing and improving work from engineers with different specialities, including AI-assisted code

  • Make thoughtful trade-offs between speed and durability, especially when a high-stakes demo or deployment creates a short deadline

  • Help create reusable patterns that make the product more coherent as the team and surface area grow

Who We're Looking For

We filter hardest on mission drive, low ego, attention to detail, and resilience under pressure. We want someone who cares about front-end engineering as a craft and can still move quickly when the problem is ambiguous.

Must-have:

  • Strong production experience with React and TypeScript, with front-end engineering as a core part of your craft

  • A track record of owning complex interfaces from problem definition through release and iteration

  • Strong product and design judgement: you notice weak hierarchy, inconsistent interactions, and confusing states before a specification points them out

  • Pragmatism and low ego: you can improve rough work from other engineers without turning every implementation choice into a philosophical debate

  • Comfort with ambiguity and changing priorities, while keeping the quality of what ships high

  • EU or UK citizenship (contractual requirement tied to our defence contracts)

Nice to have:

  • Experience with mapping, cartographic, GIS, or other geospatial applications

  • Front-end performance work involving large or real-time datasets

  • Experience building offline-capable or resource-constrained web applications

  • Experience creating or scaling a design system

  • Prior work in defence, government, or dual-use technology

What's In It For You

  • A top 0.1% European compensation package, including base salary and equity

  • Paris or London based

  • Ownership of a product surface used in real operational environments

  • Direct collaboration with product design and engineering, with room to shape front-end standards as the team grows

The Process

  1. Talent screening: 30 min, online. We cover your background, motivations, and what you want to own next.

  2. Front-end interview: 60 min, online. We assess React and TypeScript fundamentals, product judgement, and how you reason through an unfamiliar interface problem.

  3. Onsite in Paris: half day. You see the product, present a project you are proud of, and work through a front-end design and re-engineering exercise based on a realistic product problem.

  4. Roundtable: hiring committee reviews the full set of evidence and makes the final decision.

title: Head of Brand
description:
We are hiring a Head of Brand to own how Pairs shows up in the world. The brand, the content behind it, the video we put out, and the small team that makes it with you.

Pairs is where founders come to raise capital. We pair them with the right investors from a large, engaged global investor network, then our agents manage the relationships that turn into meetings. It is a two-sided platform, live with paying clients, profitable and self-funded, built by a small, senior, flat team that ships fast.

The role

You own the brand. What Pairs says, where it says it, how it looks, and the image a founder or investor meets before they ever talk to us. You set the strategy and you run it. Most weeks that means one or two high-value posts in the founders' voices and one or two from the company. You run the story shoots with the founders and investors we work with, from booking the guest through to the final cut, and you cut video yourself. There is a weekly newsletter that also lives on our site, a monthly one, and a quarterly report we want the category to quote. Paid comes later, once we turn it on, and you own the brief behind every campaign. You also get a team, VC Content Interns who live in this space, write daily, and grow into full-time seats under you. You report to the co-founders, strategize with them, and get real creative freedom.

This is a player-coach seat and both halves are real. People who stopped writing and editing when they got their first team will not enjoy this. Neither will someone who has never had anyone reporting to them, though we will hear the case.

All of it is aimed at one thing. When a founder or an investor asks ChatGPT, Perplexity or Google how raising capital works and who to raise with, we want Pairs quoted back, and we want what gets quoted to be good.

What you will own

  • Positioning, voice and look, held consistent everywhere from the site to the feed to the newsroom.

  • Weekly founder and company posts on LinkedIn and X, the newsletter on our site, the monthly one, and the quarterly report. You write them and you ship them.

  • Founder and investor story shoots, from booking and prep through shoot day to the edit, with you cutting.

  • Sponsorships and retargeting, planned and measured against inbound.

  • VC Content Interns you brief, edit and grow into full-time hires.

  • Content structured so AI answer engines and journalists quote us, with share of voice tracked and SEO fundamentals underneath.

You are a fit if you

  • Have built and run a brand end to end that we can open: a named brand where you set the voice, made the content, ran the channels, and know the before and after numbers from memory.

  • Still make it yourself. You write the posts, cut the video, direct the shoot. When we ask what you made versus what you briefed, the answer is specific.

  • Have managed makers: a small team, freelancers, or interns, and grown at least one of them into a bigger job.

  • Write at a high bar in a restrained register, and can point at published work longer than a caption.

  • Have run paid for a brand, sponsorships and retargeting included, or owned the brief and the results while someone else ran the hands.

  • Know how AI answer engines and journalists pick what to cite, and have shipped work with that reader in mind. SEO fundamentals are assumed.

  • Can take one piece that outperformed and explain exactly why, and one that flopped and what you changed.

  • Bonus: you already live in the founder and VC corner of the internet, a personal following among founders or investors, podcast or newsletter production, on-camera comfort.

What we offer

Fully remote and async. Your day overlaps with US Eastern time for a few hours, not full US hours, because that is when this audience is online. Meetings batch on Mondays and Thursdays, the rest is deep work. The best AI tooling, paid (Claude Code, Cursor, top models). Direct access to the co-founders, real creative freedom, a film library already on disk, a video team in place, and a team of interns to grow. The brand is yours to build and yours to run.

How to apply: hit apply, which takes you to our short application form. We read every application.

title: Senior Product Manager - Subscriptions
description:
Spotify's mission is to unlock the potential of human creativity by giving a million creative artists the opportunity to live off their art and billions of fans the chance to enjoy and be passionate about these creators.

The Subscriptions Mission builds and evolves Spotify's subscription products and marketplace experiences to drive sustainable user and revenue growth globally. We focus on awareness, acquisition, activation, retention, and monetization strategies that help users unlock the full value of Spotify while enabling the business to scale efficiently and responsibly.

This role focuses on the awareness, acquisition, and activation layers of the Subscriptions Mission, making Premium feel unmissable to free users long before a purchase decision. You'll own the strategy for how users discover, understand, and develop intent for Premium value, partnering closely with product, design, engineering, research, marketing, and data science to shape the moments, surfaces, and experiences that drive consideration across markets and segments.


What You Will Do
  • Own the product strategy and roadmap for how free users become aware of, experience, and develop intent for Premium, driving consideration, conversion intent, and subscriber growth across segments and markets.
  • Lead the discovery, design, and delivery of subscriber-facing features from early concept through global rollout.
  • Drive experiments that deepen our understanding of what makes users want Premium and measurably move free users closer to a purchase decision.
  • Turn behavioral, funnel, and market data into clear hypotheses, define meaningful success metrics, and build a prioritized experimentation roadmap.
  • Design rigorous A/B experiments to evaluate funnel changes against strong baselines, scaling approaches that demonstrably work across markets and segments.
  • Make pragmatic trade-offs across user value, revenue impact, regional nuance, and operational complexity, knowing when a simple flow change is enough and when a deeper platform capability is needed.
  • Partner with marketing, research, and regional teams to adapt value positioning and messaging for different markets, competitive landscapes, and user needs, including high-growth emerging markets where the path to Premium may look fundamentally different.
  • Communicate strategy, results, and trade-offs clearly to senior stakeholders, translating funnel mechanics and subscription economics into business impact and strategic direction.

    • Where You'll Be
  • You have a strong track record in product management and have shipped consumer-facing products or features at scale, with experience that translates well to subscription, marketplace, consumer growth, or media environments.
  • You have strong instincts for consumer value and what makes a product feel worth paying for, and understand how perception, positioning, and product experience work together to influence willingness to pay.
  • You can break down the path from awareness to conversion, identify the highest-leverage opportunities, and connect product decisions to downstream revenue outcomes such as ARPU, LTV, and net subscriber growth.
  • You're fluent in experimentation and A/B testing and are confident interpreting funnel, cohort, and behavioral analysis to make thoughtful prioritization decisions.
  • You know how to navigate the complexity of a global consumer business across different segments, markets, and competitive dynamics, balancing global consistency with local relevance.
  • You bring strong judgment about when to optimize, when to invest more deeply, and when to leave something alone, balancing user value, revenue impact, and operational cost.
  • You're a clear communicator and collaborative partner across product, design, engineering, marketing, research, data science, and regional teams, and you can align people around shared outcomes.
  • You're comfortable working through open-ended problems, learning quickly through experimentation, and adapting your approach based on evidence.

    • Where You Will Be
  • This role is based in London, United Kingdom or Stockholm, Sweden.

Role: Product Owner – Communication Channels & AI

Location: Manchester

Hours: Monday-Friday 8:45am-5:15pm

As Product Owner - Technical Products, your role is to own and continuously improve PHMG's Technical product portfolio, ensuring Cloud Telephony, AI Receptionist and CCE deliver measurable client value, operational quality and long-term commercial growth. 

You are accountable for translating client needs, technology capability, partner opportunities and commercial priorities into scalable products and service models that strengthen adoption, retention and PHMG's competitive position. 

Through H2 2026, you will lead the evolution of the technical product portfolio by bringing together product performance, platform capability, roadmap execution, client outcomes, commercial discipline, operational readiness and cross-functional alignment into one coherent product improvement agenda. 

Key Objectives 

Core Accountability 

  • Own the strategy, design and ongoing performance of Cloud Telephony, AI Receptionist and CCE.
  • Set a clear, prioritised roadmap that balances client value, technical feasibility, commercial return, operational capacity and partner dependency.
  • Ensure Technical products are positioned, sold, onboarded, serviced and renewed in a way that delivers measurable value for clients.
  • Define the product standards, service models and client journeys that CS and Technical Production can execute consistently.
  • Bring clarity to build, buy and partner decisions so product direction is deliberate, commercially disciplined and scalable.

 

Technical Product Strategy & Roadmap 

  • Define the long-term direction for Cloud Telephony, AI Receptionist and CCE, including the sequence of capability, integrations and service-model changes.
  • Prioritise AI Receptionist growth across both horizontal capability and the vertical use cases where PHMG has the strongest right to win.
  • Create a clear approach for CCE in the existing base, reducing under-utilisation and turning technical review, onboarding and value evidence into retention levers.
  • Partner with the Creative Product Owner so the full product set feels coherent to clients and to the teams selling and servicing it.

Client Experience, Adoption & Value Evidence 

  • Define the client experience for Technical products across onboarding, configuration, in-life usage, renewal and offboarding.
  • Clarify how clients access, configure and understand product value through the portal, including call flows, AI Receptionist behaviour, CCE setup and usage analytics.
  • Ensure CS has the standards, data and language needed to evidence value, drive adoption and manage client expectations confidently.
  • Identify where clients slow, stall or disengage, and build product or service-model interventions that protect retention.

Commercial Performance & Partner Discipline 

  • Own the commercial logic of the Technical portfolio, including pricing, CAC, cost-to-serve, gross margin, revenue performance and investment cases.
  • Operationalise the GoTo resell model with clear pricing, service, process and margin controls while protecting the partner relationship.
  • Use data to assess where Technical products create incremental value, where they cannibalise existing activity and where the model needs to change.
  • Make active trade-offs between speed, quality, margin, client experience and platform investment.

Operational Delivery & Launch Readiness 

  • Work with Technical Production and Tech to define standards, SLAs, runbooks and support models for each product and release.
  • Ensure new capabilities do not go live until operational readiness, client communications, CS briefings and support routes are clear.
  • Create tight governance for launch decisions, technical dependencies, client escalations, recurring provisioning issues and partner constraints.
  • Keep accountability clear between Product, Tech and Product Operations so issues are solved at the right level rather than absorbed by CS.

Insight, Reporting & Continuous Improvement 

  • Maintain a reliable view of product performance across adoption, usage, NPS, retention, revenue, margin, service issues and operational friction.
  • Build structured feedback loops with CS, Client Insights, Sales, Tech and Technical Production to identify product problems worth solving.
  • Turn recurring client or operational issues into permanent product, process, reporting or service-model improvements.
  • Use performance data to make early decisions before product issues become retention, margin or client-experience risks.

Established in 1998, PHMG has grown from a Manchester-founded creative business into the world's leading audio branding agency. Today, we partner with almost 40,000 clients across more than 50 countries, including global brands such as Coca-Cola, Samsung, Adidas and Audi, alongside ambitious SMEs in virtually every sector. Innovation fuels everything we do. From day one, we set out to redefine audio branding by harmonising creativity, technology and measurable results. That mindset continues to shape our evolution as we expand beyond sound into a broader suite of client communication services. In 2025, PHMG entered a defining new chapter as an employee-owned business. Ownership now sits with the people who power our creativity, performance and growth. We are proud recipients of the King's Award for Enterprise, recognised for innovation, growth and performance excellence. Today, more than 800 colleagues across six global offices collaborate to deliver work that blends artistry with commercial impact. Joining PHMG means becoming part of a people-powered, future-focused company that values creativity, champions diversity and invests in professional growth. Sound good?

Juro has big ambitions: to become the go-to platform for agreeing and managing contracts globally. And we'll need help doing it.

Legal tech is on the rise, with Goldman Sachs estimating that 44% of legal tasks can be automated with generative AI. With the brand we have built and the agility of early stage we are well placed to capture this opportunity.

Eimear (our Director of Finance) is heading off on maternity leave, and we're looking for an interim Finance Director to hold the seat for ~8 months (October to May).

This isn't a caretaker role, and it isn't a pure people-leadership role either. You're a player-coach in FP&A, meaning you’ll:

  • personally run the FY27 FP&A cycle end-to-end,

  • partner with other execs as a peer to shape strategy, and

  • coach a Financial Controller and an Analyst on everything else.

Success means:

  1. Own and run the FY27 FP&A cycle end-to-end: budget, monthly reforecast, board packs, monthly exec business reviews.

  2. Partner with the CEO and exec team as a peer, shaping board and investor reporting and influencing strategic finance decisions as they arise.

  3. Lead the finance team, with an active coaching load on month-end.

We care about building a diverse team where everyone feels they belong. That’s why our perks & benefits and choice-first work approach are designed with inclusivity in mind. Read more in our diversity, inclusion & belonging hub.

WHO WE LOOK FOR

  • You've worked in a B2B SaaS company for a significant part of the last 2 years.

  • You've personally run a full FP&A cycle end-to-end (budget, reforecasts, board reporting), not just contributed to one someone else owned.

  • You're accounting-literate and can support and challenge a controller, even if you're not the one closing the books.

  • You've been the finance owner in a diligence process. That means you've built the data room and held numbers up under external scrutiny.

  • You've partnered directly with execs and a board; not just reporting numbers to them, but shaping and influencing their decisions.

  • You've led a small finance team.

  • You've been hands-on and energised by rolling up your sleeves.

This job likely isn't for you if:

  • You need time and coaching to grow into the role; we need someone who can land running, our CEO won’t have the time to train you.

  • High-stakes corporate moments (transactions, diligence, board scrutiny) are unfamiliar territory.

  • You've never partnered with execs or led a team.

  • Your FP&A experience is "supporting" rather than owning.

OUR MISSION

Juro exists to help the world agree faster by making it incredibly easy for anyone to agree and manage legal contracts.

Frustrated by the absurdly slow process of taking a contract from inception through to agreement, Juro co-founders Richard and Pavel thought there must be a better way. They set out in 2016 to build a flexible, collaborative platform that anyone could use to process a legal contract end-to-end in their browser.

Fast forward 8 years and we have helped our customers process 2 million contracts in over 85 countries. Some of the world’s fastest-growing businesses, like Deliveroo, Remote, and Trustpilot have relied on Juro to help them streamline routine contracts at scale across multiple years of their growth.

But our story is just beginning.‍ Read more about our vision for intelligent contract automation.

description:
Title - PR & Marketing Executive

Location - Remote first but available for in person collaboration in Edinburgh or London

Aveni is redefining how financial institutions use AI. We build real, production-ready AI solutions that help financial services firms transform how they operate, manage risk and deliver better outcomes for their customers.

We’re looking for a PR & Marketing Executive to help build Aveni’s profile across the UK financial services market and support the delivery of our PR, communications and wider marketing activity.

This is a varied, hands-on role for someone who knows what makes a good story, enjoys building relationships with journalists and wants to develop their career at the intersection of AI, fintech and financial services.

 

The role

 

Working closely with the Head of PR & Communications, you’ll help tell Aveni’s story to the market, building relationships with journalists and industry influencers, identifying opportunities for Aveni to contribute to the conversation and securing relevant media coverage.

You’ll support the development of proactive PR campaigns, commentary and thought leadership around Aveni’s business priorities, product developments, customer successes and the wider issues shaping financial services.

The role goes beyond traditional media relations. You’ll also contribute to customer stories, executive and internal communications, events, awards, speaker opportunities, analyst relations and wider marketing campaigns.

You’ll work across Aveni, collaborating with Marketing, Sales, Product, Customer Success and senior leadership to make sure our communications are timely, consistent and aligned with our brand and market positioning.

 

What you’ll be doing

 

  • You’ll build and maintain relationships with journalists across UK business, financial services, fintech, compliance, risk and technology media, proactively pitching stories, commentary, interviews and contributed content.

  • You’ll support the development and delivery of PR campaigns around Aveni’s business priorities, product launches, research, customer stories and relevant market developments.

  • You’ll help run Aveni’s day-to-day press office, responding to journalist enquiries, identifying commentary opportunities, coordinating interviews and preparing briefing materials.

  • You’ll maintain our communications and editorial calendar across PR, thought leadership, research, webinars, awards, speaking opportunities and company announcements.

  • You’ll work with Sales and Customer Success to identify and develop compelling customer stories, case studies, testimonials and joint communications.

  • You’ll support internal communications, helping colleagues stay informed about company news, customer wins, product developments, events and media coverage.

  • You’ll work with Aveni’s senior leaders and subject matter experts to build their external profiles through LinkedIn content, commentary, talking points and other communications.

  • You’ll support our thought leadership programme, helping develop webinars, research reports, whitepapers and other content around the issues that matter to our market.

  • You’ll identify and coordinate relevant conference, panel, podcast and webinar speaking opportunities, as well as industry awards.

  • You’ll support our relationships with industry analysts and research organisations and help coordinate analyst briefings and materials.

  • You’ll work with the wider Marketing team to support conferences, roundtables, webinars and customer events.

 

What we’re looking for

 

  • You’ll have solid experience in PR, communications or a closely related role, with experience working in a B2B environment.

  • You’ll have experience dealing directly with journalists and proactively pitching stories and ideas.

  • You’ll be a strong writer and editor, comfortable producing press releases, pitches, commentary and other external communications.

  • You’ll have strong news judgement and be able to identify what makes a compelling story and how to tailor it for different audiences.

  • You’ll be confident communicating with journalists, senior stakeholders and external partners.

  • You’ll be able to take complex or technical subjects and turn them into clear, engaging communications.

  • You’ll be highly organised, with excellent attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple projects, deadlines and priorities at the same time.

  • You’ll understand the role PR and communications play in building brand awareness, reputation and supporting wider commercial objectives.

  • You’ll have a genuine interest in AI, fintech, financial services and the wider media agenda.

  • You’ll be comfortable working in a fast-paced environment where priorities can change quickly and be confident building relationships across the business.

  • Experience working with UK financial services, fintech, compliance, risk, regulatory or technology media.

  • Experience within a PR agency and/or an in-house B2B communications role.

  • Existing relationships with journalists covering financial services, fintech, compliance, risk or related sectors.

  • Familiarity with PR monitoring and media database platforms.

  • Experience using HubSpot or other marketing automation platforms.

  • An understanding of the UK financial services and regulatory environment, including areas such as Consumer Duty, compliance, conduct risk and AI governance.

 

Why join Aveni?

 

You’ll be joining Aveni at an exciting point in our growth, working at the intersection of AI, regulation and financial services.

You’ll have the opportunity to help shape how Aveni shows up in the market, working directly with senior leaders, subject matter experts, customers and journalists to tell stories about some of the most important changes happening across financial services.

It’s a broad role with the opportunity to build experience across media relations, thought leadership, executive communications, customer advocacy and wider marketing – while having genuine ownership and visibility across the business.

If you’re passionate about people, technology and the opportunity to help a growing AI business thrive, we’d love to hear from you.

Owing to the strategic scope of this seniority level, your responsibilities are split across two core operational pillars:

Strategy, Design & Scaling

Nice to Have

Note: This is a 6-month Fixed Term Contract (FTC) with the possibility of extension. All field-based travel, accommodation, and personal vehicle mileage expenses will be fully covered by the company.
